title: Coin Lanes: a complete Core-only game
prompt: Build a complete playable Kurot game, Coin Lanes, using the installed public @kurot/core 2.5.4 API. Read AGENTS.md first and use only this project's context, installed declarations and reference examples. Do not browse, install, upgrade or publish anything. Edit only src/** and template/web/index.html; preserve package.json, config, SDK, documentation and tsconfig. Use TypeScript strict, named exports, no any, no ts-ignore, no internal $ APIs. Use createPlayer and Kurot Shape/TextField display objects, one Player on canvas#gameCanvas, logical stage 640x800. Three lanes have centers x=120,320,520. The basket starts in lane 1 at y=680. ArrowLeft/A and ArrowRight/D move exactly one lane per non-repeated keydown, clamped to 0..2. Kurot touch begin selects floor(stageX/640*3), clamped; work correctly at a 360px viewport. No image, audio, network or backend assets. A single coin starts at y=100, falls at 300 logical pixels/second, and uses lane sequence [1,0,2] repeated. Crossing y=680 in the basket lane scores 1 and immediately spawns the next coin; otherwise crossing y=760 loses one life and immediately spawns the next. Begin with score 0 and 3 lives; zero lives ends and freezes the round. Show visible score/lives and instructions. Use DOM buttons #start, #restart, #close with those accessible names. Initial phase is ready; Start begins, Restart disposes the old round and starts a fresh playing round. Close and pagehide dispose all app-owned listeners, update callbacks and Player activity, preserve a final status, and disable controls. Keep output#status as a truthful accessibility mirror with data-phase=ready|playing|ended|disposed, data-score, data-lives, data-lane (0,1,2). Mirror every state change; this is public UI, not a test-only global. Input cannot change ended/disposed state. Retain the CLI HTML placeholders. Render a legible game on desktop and narrow mobile screens. You may run npm run typecheck and npm run build for self-checks. Deliver the implemented files, not a proposal. External acceptance runs after you finish; do not add or change tests.

acceptance.description: Frozen SDK, strict typecheck and fresh CLI development build succeed.
HTTP-served game loads a Kurot canvas with no browser or HTTP errors.
Real keyboard/touch change lanes and the deterministic first coin scores once.
Three misses end and freeze play; four restarts reset state and preserve input listener counts.
Close/pagehide remove input listeners and freeze state; mobile touch maps to logical lanes without overflow.
